falseSynonyms.zh: 民間傳說／習俗不等於 myth folklore 是整體文化傳統，包括故事、習俗、信仰。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Folklore is a broader cultural category.

falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A lie involves intentional deception.

falseSynonyms.zh: 意見不等於 myth opinion 可主觀但未必有真假判定。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An opinion is not necessarily factually false.

falseSynonyms.zh: 刻板印象不等於所有 myth stereotype 是對群體的過度簡化概括。

falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Myth is a noun; mythical is an adjective.
